notes.title: VHScape - 1.0 Release!
notes.notes:
[h3]Howdy All![/h3]

We're excited to release our first horror-themed game, inspired by similar anomaly guessing games with some new ideas. 

We got a lot of laughs watching videos of people playing the Demo and of course scaring our testers during development, and we hope you all have fun playing it too! 

Spoil yourself with some random info:
[spoiler]There are 51 anomalies [/spoiler]
[spoiler]There is a hidden Achievement[/spoiler]
[spoiler]56 different statistics are tracked using Steam Stats[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Mr. Jenkins does not make exceptions for late fees[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Too much development time was spent complaining about being scared[/spoiler]

-Kalltorak and darbs
